issues.concern: The English translation misrepresents the Japanese. The Japanese sentence means 'He has progressive ideas,' but the English translation implies that 'progressive' is an adjective describing 'ideas,' which is not the case. The Japanese '進歩的な' is an adjectival noun modifying '考え方'.
issues.suggestion: Change the English translation to 'He has progressive ideas.' or 'He has a progressive way of thinking.'
